extracted.stage: Divorce proceedings, funding sought for counsel, forensic accountant and solicitor costs
extracted.summary: A solicitor enquires about a £34,000 litigation loan for a wife in divorce proceedings where around £466,000 of property and pension assets are in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. So that we can consider it properly, we would be grateful for confirmation of the jurisdiction of the proceedings, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, and a breakdown of the £34,000 sought. It would also help to have details of the assets in dispute, including how the property and pension values have been evidenced, and confirmation of your client's position on costs to date. We will send our current criteria and application form separately, and a member of the team will be in touch once we have reviewed the information provided.
